description: Per-step 3d_path for the Frame+ESC+Motors+FC graph (v3), keyed by the graph's real part-instance UUIDs. Pose sources: frame/motor/screw from uav_animation_library.glb; nut/ESC/ESC-corner-grommet from uav_board.glb. Parts without a model or without a pose source are omitted. Not-yet-installed parts wait on a staging tray (+Z of the assembly), grouped by type; multiple identical parts in one step fly in one at a time. Fly paths include process waypoints: tray -> travel -> pre-insertion approach point -> insertion along the part's assembly direction (from animation_new part_assembly_directions.json). Node-origin positions (mm); euler angles in three.js 'XYZ' order (R = Rx*Ry*Rz), radians. | X-Lock steps re-recorded by tools/fix_xlock_paths.py: wedge assemblies built on the bench (60 mm out) and attached to the X-Lock in steps (A) and (B).
